mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS officeId, a.name AS officeName, a.type AS officeType FROM sys_office a WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.id = #{officeId} LIMIT 1

SELECT a.id AS officeId, a.name AS officeName, a.type AS officeType FROM sys_office a WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.name LIKE #{pattern} ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.name = #{officeName} THEN 0 WHEN a.name LIKE CONCAT(#{officeName}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, a.name, a.id LIMIT 21
mapper.sql: FROM sys_office a LEFT JOIN sys_office o ON o.id = a.id WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.HD_ID IS NOT NULL AND a.HD_ID <> '' AND (a.id = #{officeId} OR o.parent_ids LIKE CONCAT('%,', #{officeId}, ',%')) AND a.type IN ('6','11','22','28') AND LENGTH(a.HD_ID) = 8
FROM sys_office a WHERE a.del_flag = '0' AND a.HD_ID IS NOT NULL AND a.HD_ID <> '' AND a.type IN ('6','11','22','28') AND LENGTH(a.HD_ID) = 8
